key_insight: This review chapter surveys how laser processing can support energy generation, solar harvesting, electrochemical devices, and battery manufacturing; it is not an AI solar-cell study.
engineering_relevance: Laser-based fabrication and surface modification offer routes to improve energy-device performance, manufacturing precision, and recyclability.
method: Review laser-driven inertial confinement fusion and key laser parameters.
Survey photovoltaic optimization, concentrated solar power, and laser-assisted module recycling.
Examine surface texturing and laser techniques for lithium-ion battery materials and manufacturing.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a broad technology review but reports no quantitative results, datasets, or comparative evaluations.
watch_item: Industrial adoption requires application-specific validation of performance, safety, scalability, and processing costs.
